description.en: Application ID. You can create and query this ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.en: Channel ID to query. Only a single ID is supported.

title.en: Query Online Users in a Channel

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查询在线频道内的用户列表。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to query the list of users in an online channel.  
### QPS Limit  
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 requests per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Invoke this API appropriately.
